channel.title: HSJ - Latest news
channel.description: Custom RSS feed for HSJ latest news

item.title: Exclusive: Watchdog links patient deaths to controversial NHSE policy
item.description: A watchdog has called for a pause in the rollout of NHS England’s “advice and guidance” policy to protect safety, and linked it to two patient deaths, HSJ can reveal.

item.title: Revealed: The trusts that failed to sign up to NHSE’s financial plans
item.description: Ten trusts and one integrated care board had still not provided financially compliant plans for 2026-27 by the end of the first quarter, according to NHS England’s latest data.

item.title: Senior staff told to improve behaviour after bullying and racism findings
item.description: A trust has called for “tangible improvements” in behaviour from some of its senior clinicians, after an external review reported bullying, harassment, and racism.

item.title: Trusts pilot schemes to cut single-use products
item.description: At least 20 NHS trusts will pilot a government scheme to cut back on single-use products and increase the use of reusable alternatives for widely used items such as tourniquets, blood pressure cuffs and sharps bins.

item.title: Virtual ward referral could have prevented teenager’s death
item.description: Poor understanding and a failure in a trust’s virtual ward process contributed to the death of a 19-year-old man, a coroner has found.

item.title: Revealed: CQC ratings gap triples over a decade
item.description: The proportion of acute trusts with an overall Care Quality Commission rating that disagrees with at least one of their main hospital sites has tripled over the past decade, analysis reveals.

item.title: Top ICB confirms new CEO
item.description: A leading integrated care board has confirmed its finance director will take on the chief executive job.

item.title: FDP benefits were overestimated by £1.7bn
item.description: Government is now estimating the long-term cost-benefit of the federated data platform at £1.7bn less than the figure given by NHS England a year ago.

item.title: Hospitals must report on 25 maternity ‘deliverables’
item.description: Trusts have been told to report on 25 maternity asks by next month as part of the service’s response to two damning reviews.

item.title: Discharge system ‘a mess’, says Cooper
item.description: “System reforms” are needed to fix the “patchwork” of policies aimed at preventing hospital admissions and speeding up discharge, the health and social care secretary has said.

item.title: Consultants vote to oust CEO
item.description: Three-quarters of consultants at a trust have signed a letter declaring they have no confidence in their chief executive.

item.title: ‘Golden hellos’ offered in bid to reopen unit
item.description: A trust is offering “golden hellos” to obstetric consultants to plug gaps at a rural maternity unit, where it suspended births this week, after a recruitment round failed last month.

item.title: Group trusts to merge next year
item.description: Two trusts have announced their intention to formally merge after two years of working as a group.

item.title: ICB breached rules in £20m contract award
item.description: An integrated care board breached procurement rules while awarding a £20m general practice contract to a national corporate provider.

item.title: Mapped: Most ICBs clash with devo footprints
item.description: Just six out of 25 integrated care board and cluster footprints match a current or proposed strategic authority boundary, HSJ analysis shows.

item.title: League table positions wrong due to data error
item.description: An error in a trust’s performance data means all providers’ current positions in mental health and community trust league tables are incorrect.

item.title: Government adviser pushes for patient safety probe
item.description: Wes Streeting and the government’s maternity adviser are urging a safety body to consider investigating the NHS’s handling of a “severe yet poorly recognised” condition which can cause “life-changing harm”.

item.title: Glove prices surge 75% on Iran war disruption
item.description: The price of gloves is expected to rise by 75 per cent from next week due to the Iran war, NHS Supply Chain has warned trusts.

item.title: CEO calls for payment system shake-up
item.description: Block contracts should be replaced by payment by results to tackle “fundamentally wrong” year-long waits for children’s services, a trust chief has told HSJ.

item.title: Patient safety brief upgraded in new DHSC team
item.description: Patient safety and public health have been upgraded to a ministerial responsibility, the Department of Health and Social Care has announced.
